name: Gaussian Splat View Data Calculation
definition: A GPU compute shader that transforms Gaussian splats to screen space, evaluates view-dependent spherical harmonics, and handles 4D temporal or native 4D transformations per frame.
summary: Gaussian Splat View Data Calculation is a GPU compute shader that evaluates view-dependent spherical harmonics and 4D temporal variations to populate screen-space attributes for tiled rasterization.
